headline: Coarse-grained models link molecular structure to emergent organization in crowded cells
label: Coarse Grained Cellular Assembly Simulation
summary: Coarse-grained simulations increasingly connect molecular structure to cell-scale organization, spanning polysome mRNA conformations and minimal-cell nucleoid…
synthesis: The dominant thread is coarse-grained simulation used to connect molecular-scale description to spatial organization at cellular scale. A Kremer-Grest bead-spring molecular dynamics study reports that ribosome crowding drives mRNA in polysomes toward quasi-2D conformations, expanding its scaling exponent. A published coarse-grained model of JCVI-Syn3A attributes its expanded nucleoid and ribosome distribution to abundant positively charged proteins that screen ribosome-DNA repulsion. ioNERDSS, a Python package, converts 3D atomic structures into coarse-grained models for rule-based stochastic self-assembly simulation. What is new is the explicit link between structure-derived coarse-grained representations and emergent spatial organization in crowded cells. The remaining items, ExaTrack for single-particle tracking kinetics and PySteMoDA for steered molecular dynamics force-peak analysis, address different analytical problems and do not share this thread.
